description: Hyperliquid standing orders, by `view`. `open`: every order resting at one instant (`at`, default the newest snapshot) for a `symbol` and/or a `wallet`, in key order, each with its owner's `sizeCohort`, `pnlCohort` and `pnlCumUsd` (without `at` the current labels, with `at` those of the hour before the snapshot's own hour), optionally one cohort's, with `snapshotTs` and `source`: `l4_5m` = the node's 5-minute order snapshot (from 2026-10-23 21:45 UTC), `state_12m` = rebuilt from the ~12-minute checkpoints (from 2026-07-29; before the 5-minute feed, or while it is stalled), where short-lived orders can be missing. `wallet`: what became of one wallet's orders in a window, newest placement first: each order seen resting or filled in it, its fills in the window and a `status` (open, filled, partially_filled, canceled_or_expired); `notes` says what a snapshot cannot tell. `clusters`: one symbol's standing orders within `range_pct` of the mid of the best resting bid and ask, bucketed by price (bids and asks by limit price, take-profit and stop-loss by trigger price; trailing stops are not bucketed), optionally one cohort's. `book`: one symbol's order book at one instant, the resting limit orders summed per price (`px`, `sz`, `n` orders), `levels` a side, bids highest first and asks lowest first; `l4_5m` from 2026-11-13 08:40 UTC, `state_12m` from 2026-07-28, and `snapshotTs` is the snapshot's own time. `open`, `clusters` and `book` read the perp books unless `market=spot`. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/orders, /wallets/{address}/orders, /symbols/{symbol}/order-clusters and /symbols/{symbol}/book.

address.description: Hyperliquid wallet address: 0x followed by 40 hex characters, any case. Used by view: wallet. Required by view: wallet.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant, floored to 5 minutes. Default: the newest snapshot; not before 2026-07-29 (`book`: 2026-07-28), not in the future. On `open` and `clusters` an `at` with no complete 5-minute snapshot is rebuilt from the sightings around it, so short-lived orders can be missing; `book` answers the newest snapshot at or before it. Used by view: open, clusters, book.

cohort.description: One label on `axis`, spelled exactly as `hl_segments` view=cohorts lists it, e.g. `whale` (size) or `3x smart` (pnl). Only that cohort's orders (`open`, `clusters`). Without `at` by the current labels; with `at` by the labels of the hour before the snapshot's own hour, the ones `open` rows carry. Used by view: open, clusters.

cohort_axis.description: The ladder `cohort` is read on: `size`, `pnl` or `pnl_abs`. Default `size`. Used by view: open, clusters.

created_from.description: ISO-8601 UTC: only orders placed at or after this. Used by view: open.

created_to.description: ISO-8601 UTC: only orders placed at or before this. Used by view: open.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, passed back verbatim; it is null on the last page. Omit it for the first page. On `open` it pins the snapshot of the first page. Used by view: open, wallet.

from.description: ISO-8601 UTC start of the window. Default: 7 days before `to`. Used by view: wallet.

levels.description: Price levels per side, counted from the best price outward. Max 1000. Used by view: book.

limit.description: Rows per page. Max 1000. Used by view: open, wallet.

market.description: `perp` (the default) or `spot`. Perp and spot books are never mixed: HYPE is both. Used by view: open, clusters, book.

oid.description: One order id. 0 (the default) = every order. Used by view: open.

order_type.description: One order type; an unknown value is refused. Used by view: open.

range_pct.description: Half-width of the price range around the mid, in percent, at least 1. Max 50. Used by view: clusters.

side.description: `both` (the default), `bid` or `ask`: which side of the book to return. Used by view: book.

status.description: `open`, `filled`, `partially_filled` or `canceled_or_expired`. Omit for every status. Used by view: wallet.

step_bps.description: Bucket width in basis points of the reference price, at least 1. Max 500. Used by view: clusters.

symbol.description: Hyperliquid instrument ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE; a HIP-3 market is `dex:TICKER`, e.g. xyz:TSLA. With `market=spot` a spot pair, `HYPE/USDC` (a bare `HYPE` is `HYPE/USDC`). On `open`, `symbol` and/or `wallet` is required: an unfiltered snapshot is the whole book. Required by view: clusters, book.

to.description: ISO-8601 UTC end of the window. Default: the newest order snapshot. At most 30 days after `from`. Used by view: wallet.

view.description: What to read. `open`: the orders resting at one instant for a symbol and/or a wallet, each with its owner's labels. `wallet`: what became of one wallet's orders in a window (open, filled, canceled), newest first. `clusters`: one symbol's standing orders bucketed by price around the mid. `book`: one symbol's order book at one instant, price levels best first. Default `open`.

wallet.description: `open`: one wallet's resting orders, 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Used by view: open.

name: hl_orders
title: Hyperliquid Orders
